data.name: Shivram
data.gender_notes: Shivram is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lord Shiva is the god of destruction and transformation, while Ram is an incarnation of Lord Vishnu. This name represents the union of both deities, symbolizing the power to destroy old patterns and transform into a new, stronger self. The name Shivram carries the meaning “Shiva + Ram” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Marathi. Parents who choose Shivram usually hope their child will grow to embody shiva + ram and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shivram is a powerful and spiritual name, inspired by the Hindu gods Shiva and Rama. It is believed that the name brings the blessings of both deities, granting strength, protection, and the power to overcome challenges.
data.etymology: Shivram belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Shiva + Ram.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shivram total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shivram holds significant cultural importance in Hinduism as it combines two powerful deities representing change, destruction, and transformation. It reflects the deep spiritual beliefs of ancient Hindu society and is deeply rooted in their culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Shivram lies in the belief that life is cyclical, and that destruction and transformation are an essential part of the journey towards personal growth and spiritual evolution. This name encourages individuals to face challenges with courage and strength, and to embrace change with an open mind and a fearless spirit. It signifies the inner transformation of the self and the destruction of negative patterns and limiting beliefs, leading to spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Shivram is a name that embodies the divine qualities of Lord Shiva and Vishnu. Shiv signifies Lord Shiva, the destroyer and transformer, while Ram represents Lord Rama, the preserver and protector. Together, they symbolize the cyclical balance of creation, preservation, and destruction in the universe.
